name: How often should I repaint my home's interior?

mainEntity.name: How often should I repaint my home's interior?

acceptedAnswer.text: The frequency of interior repainting depends on factors like traffic in your home, lifestyle, and your desire for change. Generally, living rooms and bedrooms might need repainting every 5-7 years. High-traffic areas like kitchens, bathrooms, and hallways may benefit from a refresh every 3-5 years due to more wear and tear. High-quality paint and proper preparation can extend these intervals.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repaint your home's interior every 5-7 years for living areas, and 3-5 years for high-traffic zones, depending on wear and lifestyle.
